oracle: Actual Google Chrome 154 pointer submissions and top-level navigation over a same-origin local Vite server, with production apps/web renderMarkdown() / DOMPurify for authored HTML and real browser parsing for responses.

notes.authoredHtml: The authored source is passed through the pinned web renderMarkdown() / DOMPurify path before real click submissions.
notes.responseParsing: Response documents and charset samples are static HTML bytes parsed by Chrome; they contain no scripts and their behavior is not simulated.
notes.redirectCoverage: GET and POST forms are submitted through each of 301, 302, 303, 307, and 308 redirects. Raw request URLs and body bytes are recorded at both hops.
notes.sameDocument: An anchor fragment click is measured separately from GET form submissions to the same path with a fragment.
notes.history: Back/Forward are actual browser history operations. BFCache persisted values are recorded as observed for this Chrome run, without claiming cross-browser guarantees.
notes.style: Response documents expose body, h1, p, a, input, and button computed styles and rectangles at 390/768px in light/dark color schemes; a blank viewport corner pixel is sampled from Chrome screenshots.
notes.networkScope: Every endpoint and image is served from 127.0.0.1:18921. No outside requests, cookies, or authentication are used.
notes.mime: Static text/plain and application/json responses record browser document DOM, preformatted text, available controls, and computed styles. Any Chrome viewer UI is recorded as observed.
